components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Turns the human on the centre into an Original vampire.

The target must be human: no faction and no species. A villager must stand in the circle: it is the sacrifice, and it is killed.
A server can cap how many Originals exist; at the cap the rite is refused and the ingredients come back.
Needs a full moon: the moon must be full, between dusk and dawn, in the Overworld. An eclipse counts too. The hub's moon calendar shows when the next one rises.
